name: Hessdalen Lights
description: Recurring unexplained luminous phenomena observed in the Hessdalen valley of central Norway, instrumentally recorded since the early 1980s and the subject of a long-running scientific monitoring programme.
origin: The phenomenon is concentrated almost entirely within the Hessdalen valley (Holtålen municipality) in Sør-Trøndelag, central Norway, with occasional reports from neighbouring valleys.
